title: Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A Python tool for generating and evaluating synthetic multi-table datasets, using SDV's Metadata schema and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to train per-table models and sdmetrics' QualityReport to assess fidelity. SDV's single-table Gaussian copula synthesizer and metadata API are directly imported and run, while HMASynthesizer was tried and abandoned as too slow.
